from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
src = Path('/inputs/README.md')
out = Path('/work/README.md')
files = sorted(Path('/inputs').glob('*-*.md'), key=lambda p: p.name)
rows=[]
for p in files:
    title=None
    for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title=line[2:].strip()
            break
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No level-one heading in {p}')
    rows.append(f'| [{p.name}](../inputs/{p.name}) | .md | {title} |')
append = ('\n## Reference index\n\n'
          '| File | Type | Description |\n'
          '| --- | --- | --- |\n' +
          '\n'.join(rows) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
data = src.read_bytes() + append
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/work', prefix='.README.', suffix='.tmp')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, out)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)
print(f'wrote {len(data)} bytes with {len(rows)} rows')
